heading: ## Spec evolution

heading: ## Task-runner discipline

A test asserting a check runs would be indirection, not coverage. Adjudicated under livespec-runtime-mqsxsu.2.

heading: ## Test discipline

The section governs the SUITE, so a test inside the suite cannot be its own witness. Adjudicated under livespec-runtime-mqsxsu.2.
